cohort: The study included 22,136 records of newborns hospitalized in a neonatal unit between 2009 and 2022.
finding: Despite a high prevalence of exclusive breastfeeding (91.55%) at hospital discharge, factors such as cesarean delivery, illicit substance use, low birth weight, and cleft lip and palate were negatively associated, while breastfeeding counseling and labor and delivery support promoted exclusive breastfeeding.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was negatively associated with exclusive breastfeeding at hospital discharge (OR: 0.90).
birth_weight: N/A (low birth weight was an exposure, but no overall cohort weight range provided)
